command_list: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'TASK.md' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' -g '"'!target'"' ."
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat TASK.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
D=json.load(open('declarations.json'))
print(type(D).__name__,len(D)); print(json.dumps(D[:5],indent=2))
P=[json.loads(x) for x in open('passages.jsonl')]
print('passages',len(P)); print(json.dumps(P[:2],indent=2))
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'wc -l lean/Spec/*.lean lean/Spec/*/*.lean && cat lean/Spec/Lexicon.lean lean/Spec/Grammar/Syntax.lean'

/bin/zsh -lc 'cat lean/Spec/Grammar.lean lean/Spec/Grammar/Tree.lean lean/Spec/Grammar/File.lean lean/Spec/Grammar/Script.lean lean/Spec/Grammar/Properties.lean lean/Spec/Regex.lean lean/Spec/Lexicon/Properties.lean lean/Spec/Lexicon/Tokenization.lean lean/Spec/Parser/VersionPolicy.lean lean/Spec/Reader.lean'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat lean/Spec/Lexer.lean'
/bin/zsh -lc "cat lean/Spec/Parser/Properties.lean && sed -n '1,350p' lean/Spec/Parser/Traversal.lean"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '340,695p' lean/Spec/Parser/Traversal.lean"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
P=list(map(json.loads,open('passages.jsonl')))
for p in P:
 if (p['version']=='2.7' and (re.search(r'ignor|tokeniz|delimit|maximal|longest|end.of.file|first command|:smt-lib-version',p['text'],re.I) or p['heading'] in ['Exiting','Exiting the solver'])) or (p['version']=='2.0' and p['page']==22) or (p['version']=='2.6' and p['page']==24):
  print(p['id'],p['text'])
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
P=list(map(json.loads,open('passages.jsonl')))
for p in P:
 if (p['version']=='2.6' and p['production'] in ['term','pattern'] and p['section']=='B') or (p['version']=='2.0' and p['page']==72) or (p['version']=='2.7' and p['page']==33) or (p['version']=='2.5' and p['page']==87):
  print(p['id'],p['text'])
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'mkdir -p out'
/bin/zsh -lc 'python3 out/build_matches.py'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'

 if r['tension']: print(r['id'],':',r['tension']['description'])
